request.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE square 1024x1024 image. The first 4 attached images are STYLE references only (frame, flat shapes, palette); do not copy their birds. The last 1 attached image(s) are earlier versions of this same bird icon: improve on them as the art director's change below says. Save the generated PNG into the current working directory as out.png and reply with only its path. This is variation 4; vary the composition a little. Image brief:
Flat geometric bird icon in a Mondrian / De Stijl spirit, matching the reference images. A thick navy square frame (#0B0F24) around an ivory field (#FAF6EE). Right-facing head-and-upper-breast portrait. The bird is a bold navy silhouette with a few flat color fields; it may run off the bottom and left edges of the frame only, and leaves clear ivory space between the bill tip, crest and the frame. One simple round eye. Use only these colors: navy #0B0F24, ivory #FAF6EE, chrome yellow #F7B902, vermilion #C7301C, Klein blue #002FA7, slate #5E6178. Three or four colors in total. No gradients, shading, texture, outlines of feather detail, scenery, text or labels. Simple shapes that stay readable at 32 pixels.

Species: American Barn Owl (Tyto furcata). Identifying features to show: white heart-shaped facial disc with a buff rim; dark eyes; small pale bill in the middle of the face; pale golden-buff back; white or pale buff front. Proportions measured from a photo: face disc to head width = 0.9. Do not draw: a dark navy body; ear tufts.
Art director's change for this version: Keep the design of the base icon (heart-shaped face, slightly turned), but make the body pale: a chrome-yellow buff back and an ivory front instead of navy.
